release_notes: Specs per official IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Video Systems) datasheet (ndp_7803s_z30l_data_sheet_enus_171699840267.pdf), linked from the IQSIGHT product page. IP66 pendant with integrated IR. Operating temperature -40 to 50 C with IR on (-40 to 60 C with IR off). Power 66.6 W max at 36 VDC (64.8 W PoE, 84 VA at 24 VAC). Intelligent tracking listed as built-in; IVA Pro Intelligent Tracking is a separate license.

frigate.notes: Bosch official RTSP scheme: /?inst=1 main, /?inst=2 sub (per Bosch 'RTSP usage with Bosch Video IP Devices'). Default admin user is 'service' (no factory default password — set one first). ONVIF Profile S/G (T/M on INTEOX). Not individually bench-tested.

home_assistant.notes: Generic ONVIF integration; Bosch CPP cameras are ONVIF Profile S/G compliant. Use the 'service' account.
